item.title: Miles-long backup hits I-5 south as Fife DUI suspect fights WA state trooper
item.description: A DUI suspect's fight with troopers, a reported 102 mph crash, and miles-long I-5 backups snarled Fife's morning commute on Friday.

item.title: Longtime Seattle journalist, former FOX 13 reporter Steve Kiggins dies at 47
item.description: Former FOX 13 Seattle reporter and photojournalist Steve Kiggins died on Feb. 12 after a decades-long journalism career that took him from the Pacific Northwest to the Deep South and back home again.

item.title: Bellevue police accuse Romanian organized crime group of ‘blessing’ scam
item.description: A Romanian organized crime group accused of targeting people across King County with a "blessing" scam is facing felony charges.

item.title: Sound Transit to launch 'simulated service' Seattle to Bellevue. What this means
item.description: Starting Feb. 14, Light rail riders will see more trains and new boarding procedures during Crosslake Connection testing. Here’s how 1 Line and 2 Line service will work before the March 28 opening.

item.title: 'Seattle News Weekly': Recap of the Super Bowl parade
item.description: On this week's episode of the Seattle News Weekly podcast, FOX 13's Hana Kim and Austin Lane discussed the excitement surrounding the Super Bowl and the parade in Seattle.

item.title: Jamaican man pleads guilty in $550K Vancouver, WA lottery scam
item.description: A Jamaican man pleaded guilty in Tacoma to a lottery scam that stole more than $550,000 from a 73-year-old Washington woman.

item.title: Filtered sunshine on Valentine's Day in Seattle
item.description: Tonight, we'll stay mainly cloudy with showers gradually falling apart. We’ll be watching for the chance of a convergence zone, particularly across the North Sound early Saturday.

item.title: Where's 'Little' Antonio's football? Seattle Seahawks fan loses signed ball at parade
item.description: A young Seahawks fan managed to get a football signed by several players during Wednesday's parade. But, one wrong bounce and it's been lost.

item.title: Seattle homeless encampment sweep brings hope, but worries remain
item.description: Crews have cleared a homeless encampment near local businesses in Seattle's Ballard neighborhood, leaving owners relieved, but also counting the cost of months of disruption, theft, and vandalism.

item.title: Seattle Amazon workers rally to cut company ties with ICE
item.description: Amazon workers and advocacy groups rallied in Seattle on Friday, urging the company to cut ties with ICE and other federal agencies.
